newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends slightly firmer after rate move.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends slightly firmer after rate move.

text.p: Britain's leading blue chip share index ended with modest gains on Thursday as the market breathed a collective sigh of relief that the Bank of England raised official interest rates by only 25 basis points, dealers said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 closed 5.4 points higher at 4,767.8, near the day's best level, with advancers narrowly outpacing decliners 54 to 45.

Shares got off to a weak start after the Dow tumbled 119 points on Thursday, but pared losses and swung into positive ground later after the Bank of England raised the base lending rate to 6.75 percent from 6.50 percent, as expected.
